note: Every ChatGPT DOM fact the driver reads. Data only: CSS selectors, attribute names and plain labels, each of the type cdp_consult._CONTRACT_SCHEMA declares (the loader refuses anything else). A UI change is fixed here; a changed widget protocol, and what may be clicked to send, are code.

turn_schemas.why: Message units, one schema per UI generation. Readers union them in list order (the first attribute present names the role); the send contract tries them one at a time by send_rank, never unioned (data-turn first: that build keeps author-role on the user node only). role_from 'value': attr="user|assistant"; 'last_colon_segment': attr="<turn>:<n>:user|assistant". level 'turn' tags the turn wrapper, 'message' the message itself. author-role 2026-07-01; data-turn ~2026-08; search-unit 2026-09-24.

assistant_body.why: The answer's markdown body inside an assistant unit; attachment cards follow it in the same unit (2026-09-24).

turn_container.why: The turn wrapper holding a user unit, its answer and its activity header, where the failure marker lives (2026-09-25).

conversation_root.why: The conversation region; the sidebar's thread titles are outside it (2026-07).

failure_markers.why: Whole text of a leaf status element in the turn, outside any message body, when a turn will never answer (2026-09-25).

model_slug_attr.why: The producing model's slug on the answer's message node (2026-09-06).

composer.why: The ProseMirror editor; the visible one inside a form is the composer (2026-07-01).

composer_exclude_ancestor.why: An editor inside a message is an edit-message box, not the composer (2026-07).

composer_plus_button_id.why: The composer form's attach button, a menu button that is not a model switcher (2026-08-28).

trailing_break_class.why:
The editor's placeholder
that keeps an empty or line-final block open; not payload (2026-10-13).

mention_chip_attr.why: A picked app becomes <span app-mention-name> in the composer; a file row does not (2026-09-29).

mention_chip_label_attr.why: The chip's display name, preferred over app-mention-name (2026-09-29).

mention_popup_attr.why: The @ popup's scroll area; the popup carries no ARIA roles (2026-09-29).

mention_option_attr.why: Every popup row (plugin, file, action) is a <button> with this attribute (2026-09-29).

mention_row_content_attr.why: A row's content block: leading icon, then label and description (2026-09-29).

mention_app_icon_class.why: Class on a connector app's leading icon; actions and files use other icons (2026-09-29).

mention_description_class.why: Class of a row's description element (2026-09-29).

mention_section_header.why: Lower-cased popup section header above app rows (2026-09-29).

picker_owner.why: The open model picker's group holding the family radios and the tier slider (2026-08-18).

picker_menu.why: A Radix menu; the picker is the one holding a slider when the owner testid is absent (2026-08-18).

picker_slider.why: The tier slider (aria-valuenow 0..4, Pro = 4) inside the picker menu (2026-08-18).

picker_menuitem.why: The slider's wrapper row; its aria-describedby targets carry the tier announcement (2026-09-06).

picker_family_radio.why: A model family radio (aria-checked) in the picker owner (2026-09-06).

picker_radio_scaffold.why: Radio-group chrome; present with no readable radio means half-rendered (2026-09-06).

picker_flat_items.why: The flat-menu layout where a tier is a plain item (pre-2026-08-18 builds, and the effort submenu).

picker_submenu_trigger.why: An Effort/Model row that opens a submenu (2026-08-18; none on the 2026-09-06 build).

picker_open_trigger.why: The composer switcher whose menu is open, read within the form (2026-08-28).

picker_open_menus.why: Menus an Escape is dispatched at; Radix keeps closed ones mounted (2026-09-06).

switcher_labels.why: Leading text of a composer model/tier switcher button (case-sensitive prefix; version-shaped labels like '5.5' and 'o3' are matched by code). Tiers 2026-08-18, GPT badge 2026-09-06.

switcher_not_labels.why: Case-insensitive leading text of buttons that are never a model switcher ('Upgrade to Pro' must not confirm Pro) (2026-07).

family_aliases.why: Observed family radio label -> the family it is. 'Latest' was relabelled 'GPT-6' in 2026-10, same model, same slot.

blocker_login.why: A login form on the page (2026-07-01).

blocker_login_paths.why: First path segment of a login page (2026-07-01).

blocker_alert.why: Where a rate-limit notice is shown (2026-07-01).

rate_limit_phrases.why: Case-insensitive phrases in the alert that mean a rate limit (2026-07-01).
